scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Access to Premium content is only available to those who possess a certain amount of Reset Stones.
scripts.translation:
[不知從何處傳來的聲音]
只有持有足夠重置石的人，才能體驗高階內容。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Would you like to participate in this quest for 1 ^0000CCReset Stone^000000?
scripts.translation:
[不知從何處傳來的聲音]
您願意使用1顆^0000CC重置石^000000參與這個任務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Good luck, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[不知從何處傳來的聲音]
祝你好運，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
In order to change to third class, you must bring 1 ^0000CCReset Stone^000000 or have a Premium account.
scripts.translation:
[不知從何處傳來的聲音]
要進行三轉，你必須攜帶1顆^0000CC重置石^000000，或擁有高階賬號。

scripts.text:
[Voice from nowhere]
Very well.
scripts.translation:
[不知從何處傳來的聲音]
好的。

scripts.text:
[King Crab]
Khh ha ha ha ha ha ha.
That little rookie was knocked out by my one blow!
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
咔哈哈哈哈！
那隻小菜鳥，我一拳就打暈了！

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
Those arrogant fellows deserve a bitter lesson.
How dare a little rookie attack you, boss!
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
那些傲慢的傢伙該好好教訓一下了。
一個小新人竟然敢攻擊你，老大！

scripts.text:
[King Crab]
Khhha ha ha ha ha ha!!!!
One more cup of beer, here!!!
I will drink today!!!
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
咔哈哈哈哈！！！！
來，再上一杯啤酒！！！今天我要喝個痛快！！！

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
King Crab!!! I will follow you forever!!
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
帝王蟹！！！我永遠追隨你！！

scripts.text:
[King Crab]
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!!!
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
Hey! Right here!!! One more cup of beer!!!
What are you doing? My boss's cup is already empty! Come quickly!
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
喂！在這裡！！！！再來一杯啤酒！！！！
你在幹什麼？老大的杯子已經空了！快點過來！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Yes, I will bring it right away.
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
好的，我馬上就來。

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
Too slow!!! Who do you think my boss is? Huh!?
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
太慢了！！！！你以為我老大是誰？哼！？

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
I... I'm really sorry, sir...
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
我...真的很抱歉，先生...

scripts.text:
[King Crab]
K k k k k. That's enough.
That cute girl seems to be scared of you!
Hey lady~ We are not scary people~~
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
嘿嘿嘿嘿，行了，瞧你把那小美人嚇的！
小姐~我們又不是什麼壞人~~

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Aaaaaaaaaaak! Don't do this!!
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
啊啊啊啊啊！別這樣！！

scripts.text: - Bang -

[???]
Hey, there.
I've been watching you, making a ruckus like you own this place.
scripts.translation:
[???]
喂，那邊的。
看你們吵了半天，不知道的還以為這兒是你們家。

scripts.text:
[???]
It's too noisy. So if you want to say that nonsense again, go home.
scripts.translation:
[???]
太吵了，想繼續說那些廢話，就滾回家說。

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
What?!
I don't know who you are but you must've lost your mind!
Do you have any idea who my boss is?!!
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
什麼？！
我不知道你是誰，但你一定是瘋了！
你知道我老大是誰嗎？！！

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
This is the famous King Crab!!!
Who can decimate entire armies with his fist!!!
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
這就是著名的帝王蟹！！！
能用拳頭摧毀整支軍隊的人！！！

scripts.text:
[???]
You do all the dirty things like your dirty face.
You're just a thug satisfying your desires.
scripts.translation:
[???]
臉髒，乾的事也髒，不過是個只顧滿足私慾的流氓。

scripts.text:
[King Crab]
What?
How dare you say those things?
Just because you're a girl doesn't mean I'll just let it go.
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
什麼？你還真敢說啊！
別以為是個女人，我就會放過你。

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
Huh! The boss is really mad!
I can beat you up with one blow...
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
哼！老大真的生氣了！
我一下就能把你打倒...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey! How dare you use violence against a lady!?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂！你竟敢對女士使用暴力！？

scripts.text:
[???]
Move back, you little thing...

[???]
Oh, I'm glad to hear that.
I won't attack first because I'm in the middle of training.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，那可太好了。
我正在修行，不能先動手。

scripts.text:
[King Crab & Sludge Worm]
What?
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹與汙泥蟲]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[King Crab & Sludge Worm]
Uhhhh?!
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹與汙泥蟲]
呃？？！

scripts.text:
[King Crab & Sludge Worm]
Aaaaaahhhhhhhhk!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹與汙泥蟲]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
- What is that amazing power? -
- I've never seen this -
- kind of skill before... -
scripts.translation: - 好驚人的力量！我從來沒見過這樣的招式... -

scripts.text:
[???]
Well, the mood is spoiled...

[Waitress]
Tha... Thank you so much...
How can I repay you?
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
謝...太感謝你了...
我該怎麼報答你呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
It's not a big deal. It's okay.
scripts.translation:
[???]
沒什麼大不了的。沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Are you going back to your lodging?
If it's okay with you, can I deliver you a meal?
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
你要回住處嗎？
如果不介意的話，我可以給你送份餐嗎？

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, you don't really need to.
Just a slice of bread and warm soup will be enough for me.
Then, I've got to say goodbye. Bye.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，不用那麼麻煩。
一片面包和熱湯就足夠了。
那麼，我該告辭了。再見。

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Bye...
...
.....
........(cheeks glowing)

[King Crab]
How come a little rookie knocked me out! Me! The great King Crab...
scripts.translation:
[帝王蟹]
為什麼一個新人就能把我打倒！我！偉大的帝王蟹...

scripts.text:
[Sludge Worm]
Boss... Are we really past our prime now?
Sob... sob...
scripts.translation:
[汙泥蟲]
老大...我們真的過氣了嗎？
嗚嗚...嗚嗚...

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Oh dear~
I really appreciate you, {0}, for helping me a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
哎呀~
{0}，真的很感謝你剛才幫了我。

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Ah, the person we saw before?
She has been staying in this village for days,
Isn't she so great?
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
啊，剛才那位？
她在村裡已經住了幾天，厲害吧？

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Now that the customers have become a little quiet.
Ahhhh, I feel better now!!
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
現在顧客稍微安靜一點了。
啊哈，我現在感覺好多了！！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Oh no~
I hate those noisy and impolite customers!
I hope there is someone who can scold them for me.
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
哎呀~
我討厭那些吵鬧又不禮貌的顧客！
真希望有人能替我教訓他們。

scripts.text:
Ah, the person we saw before?
She has been staying in this village for days,
Isn't she so great?
scripts.translation:
啊，剛才那位？
她在村裡已經住了幾天，厲害吧？

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Although she is a woman like me, she was so cool!
Aaahh~ That beautiful and imposing figure...
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
同樣是女人，她可真帥氣！
啊~那漂亮又威風的身姿...

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Oh my!!
I forgot to do something!
I should cook right away and then bring the meal to the Inn. Aaahh~
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
哎呀！！差點忘了正事！
得趕緊做好飯，送到旅館去，啊~

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
If you still don't know where to stay, please use ^f57d7dthe Inn at the upper side of this building^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女服務員]
如果還沒找到住處，可以去^f57d7d這棟建築上方的旅館^000000。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who is it?!

[{0}]
I am the person who was at the pub a while ago.
I have something to ask.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是剛才在酒館的那個人。
我有事想問。

scripts.text:
[???]
Don't bother me, just go away!
scripts.translation:
[???]
別煩我，快滾！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please, I just want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜託了，我只是想聊聊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't ignore me, just talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別不理我，跟我說話吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just for a moment, isn't it okay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就一小會兒，不行嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not here to hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有惡意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How could you treat someone who came to your door so badly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎麼能對上門拜訪的人這麼無禮？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're going too far.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你太過分了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
After I saw you fighting...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剛才看到你打架...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought that you must have practiced martial arts and I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想你一定練過武術，所以來這裡見你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But seeing that you stood me up outside like this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你卻像這樣把我晾在外面...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be advanced in martial arts...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來你的武術造詣很深...

scripts.text:
[???]
How persistent...

[???]
What the hell do you want?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你到底想幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fighter]
Ahhhh~ I'm so tired.
Training is so tough and I have a long way to go!
scripts.translation:
[格鬥家]
啊~累死了。
修煉真辛苦，我還差得遠呢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know about the skill you used a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道你剛才用的那個技能。

scripts.text:
[???]
...
......
.........
............ A rookie like you doesn't need to know.

[{0}]
Rookie?!
I have steadily practiced martial arts.
I am confident that I will never lose.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
新人？！
我一直都在刻苦練習武藝。
我有信心絕不會輸。

scripts.text:
[???]
So you can beat me, too?
scripts.translation:
[???]
這麼說，你也能打贏我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No...
I guess that's too much...
Frankly speaking, I was quite amazed by you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不...那恐怕還差得遠...
說實話，你的身手讓我大開眼界。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I had thought that I was strong enough but after seeing you fight, I realized that I was full of conceit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我本以為自己已經足夠強大了，但看了你的戰鬥後，我才意識到自己不過是自滿罷了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Huuuh~ No matter how strong you are,
you cannot avoid reaching for your true limit.
scripts.translation:
[???]
呼~再強的人，也終究會撞上自己的極限。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are just the person that I expected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你正是我所期待的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think you would know
how to overcome this limitation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想你一定知道，該怎麼突破這個極限。

scripts.text:
[???]
Stop it.

[{0}]
What? Why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？為什麼？

scripts.text:
[???]
Are you a human?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你是人類嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?
Of course, I am a human.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？
當然，我是人類。

scripts.text:
[???]
To become stronger is too hard for a mere human.
If you want to, just buy better equipment.
scripts.translation:
[???]
對於普通人類來說，變強太難了。
如果你想要變強，去買更好的裝備吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what are you?
You mean you're not a human being?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你是什麼？
你的意思是你不是人類？

scripts.text:
[???]
To overstep the limit...
is impossible for a human.
It's a ghost's way...
scripts.translation:
[???]
超越極限...不是人類能走的路。
那是鬼神之道...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ghost?

[???]
I gave up being a human after I chose this way.
The way to become a Sura abandoning divine protection.
scripts.translation:
[???]
選了這條路，我就不再以人類自居。
捨棄神明的庇護，化身修羅，就是這條道路。

scripts.text:
[???]
You won't even have time to take a rest if you choose this way.
You'll become a puppet for war...
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果你選擇這條路，連休息的時間都沒有。
你會淪為戰爭的傀儡...

scripts.text: But I still want to know more.
scripts.translation: 但我還是想了解更多

scripts.text: Well, I quit then.
scripts.translation: 算了，我放棄

scripts.text:
[???]
Aren't you an idiot?
Why are you so happy about becoming a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你是不是傻？
做鬼神有什麼值得高興的？

scripts.text:
[???]
You'll regret it, so just be satisfied with your present life.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你會後悔的，所以還是安分守己，過好自己的生活吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, now that I've met you, I won't live my life this way anymore!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然遇到了你，我就不再這樣渾渾噩噩地活下去了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Hah... you're really making me tired.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈...真是讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[???]
Okay, then^f57d7d go and kill 100 Desert Wolves.^000000
After that, I'll think about it again.
scripts.translation:
[???]
好吧，那就^f57d7d去殺100只沙漠之狼^000000。
之後我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[???]
Well, good choice.
You don't need to look for trouble.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯，不錯的選擇。
你不需要自找麻煩。

scripts.text:
[???]
Wow~
Did you really kill all those wolves?
I figured you'd have given up.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哇~
你真的殺光了那些狼？
我還以為你會放棄呢。

scripts.text:
[???]
A woman's word is her bond!!
A promise is a promise.
scripts.translation:
[???]
女子一言既出，駟馬難追！！
承諾就是承諾。

scripts.text:
[???]
Go to ^f57d7dEl Mes Gorge Southeast of Juno^000000.
My colleague ^f57d7dBuddy^000000 will be training himself near the center of that area.
scripts.translation:
[???]
去^f57d7d朱諾東南方的爾邁斯峽谷^000000。
我的同事^f57d7d巴迪^000000正在該區域中心附近修煉。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Tell him that 'Bruno' sent you there and after that, just suit yourself.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
告訴他，是“布魯諾”派你來的，之後隨你便了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Hah... you're really making me tired.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哈...真是讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[???]
Okay, then^f57d7d go and kill 100 Desert Wolves.^000000
Then I'll think about it again.
scripts.translation:
[???]
好吧，那就^f57d7d去殺100只沙漠之狼^000000。
之後我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Go to ^f57d7dEl Mes Gorge Southeast of Juno^000000.
My colleague ^f57d7dBuddy^000000 will be training himself near the center of that area.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
去^f57d7d朱諾東南方的爾邁斯峽谷^000000。
我的同事^f57d7d巴迪^000000正在該區域中心附近修煉。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Tell him that 'Bruno' sent you there and after that, just suit yourself.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
告訴他，是“布魯諾”派你來的，之後隨你便了。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Hey~ !
How are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
嘿~！
最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Don't you have any presents for your teacher?
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
你難道沒有給老師準備禮物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
I recommend you to reconsider being a Sura.
Sura is strong and cool, but that's not all.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
我建議你重新考慮一下成為修羅的事。
修羅雖然強大且帥氣，但這並不是全部。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Me?
If I need to choose a job again, I will definitely choose Sura.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
我？
如果讓我重新選擇職業，我一定會選擇修羅。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Haaap!!! Haaaap!!! Whoo!! Haahhp!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
哈啊！！哈啊！！呼！！哈啊！！

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
I don't know why you're here but please don't stand behind me unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我不知道你為什麼在這裡，但除非你想死，否則別站在我身後。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Haaap!!! Haaaap!!! Whoo!! Haahhp!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
哈啊！！哈啊！！呼！！哈啊！！

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
I don't know why you're here but please don't stand behind me unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我不知道你為什麼在這裡，但除非你想死，否則別站在我身後。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Bruno' sent me here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是“布魯諾”派我來的。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Ah! My colleague introduced me to you!
Anyway, why are you here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
啊，是同門介紹來的！
那麼，你找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I asked Bruno about her strength, and she recommended me to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想向布魯諾請教變強的方法，她便叫我來找你。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
That difficult girl... no, just kidding.
You must be a special person for her to send you to me.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
那個難纏的丫頭...開個玩笑。
能讓她送來的人，你肯定不一般。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Well, I can't answer your question because I'm in the process of self-training, so I will take you to our master.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我也還在修煉，答不了你的問題，還是帶你去見師父吧。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我的師父不喜歡吵鬧，所以請^f57d7d在客廳裡安靜地等待。^000000

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
This way...
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
這邊請...

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Ah, long time no see, {0}.
Are you here to meet my master?
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
啊，好久不見，{0}。
你是來見我的師父的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
I'll take you right away.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我馬上帶你去。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Then, why are you here?
You are not here to see me, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
那麼，你來這裡做什麼？
你不是來見我的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
{0}, didn't you meet the master yet?
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
{0}，你還沒見過師父嗎？

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我的師父不喜歡吵鬧，所以請^f57d7d在客廳裡安靜地等待。^000000

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
This way...
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
這邊請...

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
我的師父不喜歡吵鬧，所以請^f57d7d在客廳裡安靜地等待。^000000

scripts.text: Go to the living room.
scripts.translation: 去客廳

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Please wait in the living room at the upper side.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
請到上方的客廳等候。

scripts.text:
[Buddy]
Then, see you again.
scripts.translation:
[巴迪]
那麼，下次再見。

scripts.text: I'll show you the way. This way.
scripts.translation: 我帶你去。這邊請。

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Hey~ {0}, what's up?
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
嘿~ {0}，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Let's have conversation.
scripts.translation: 聊聊

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
My master?
He said he has put the world out of his mind and he is a ghost who gave up being a human but he seems to have a lingering desire for the world.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
師父？
嘴上說已經捨棄塵世、放棄做人，走上鬼神之道，可他似乎還是放不下這人間。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Well, I am also a Sura but I still enjoy traveling and meeting many people~
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
嗯，雖然我也是修羅，但我還是很喜歡旅行和結識很多人~

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
In the old days, my master had one close friend but after becoming a Sura,
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
從前，師父有個很要好的朋友，可成了修羅以後...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
I heard that he wrote a letter to the friend that he had died.
Then he sometimes visits 'the place of memory' secretly.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
聽說他給那位朋友寫了封信，說自己已經死了。
可現在還會偷偷去故地，追憶往事。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
It would be better not saying that he died and just keep meeting his friend.
He's a bit of a stick-in-the-mud.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
其實不說自己死了，繼續和朋友見面不是更好嗎。
他有點古板。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
But he is really cool and awesome.
Ho ho.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
但他真的很酷，很厲害。
呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
The reason why I keep traveling is to find 'the precious friend' of my master and not to training myself more.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
我之所以不斷旅行，是為了尋找師父的“摯友”，而不是為了磨練自己。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
I feel heavy-hearted when I see my master missing his friend...
It's not... not just for my... master!
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
看著師父思念朋友的樣子，我心裡也不好受...
才...才不只是為了...師父呢！

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Wow~ I thought you would be knocked out before seeing my master but you are finally here now?
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
哇~ 我以為你在見到師父之前就會被打倒，沒想到你居然真的來了？

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Anyway you are here now, so I am your immediate superior.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
不過，既然入了門，我就是你的師姐了。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
We don't care about your age in our world!
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
我們這兒，可不是按年齡排輩的！

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Come again whenever you want to~
I will show you the training course of the dead~
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
歡迎隨時再來~
我會讓你見識一下“死亡”的訓練課程~

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
What are you?
How did you find this place!
Go away!!!
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
你是誰？
你怎麼找到這裡的！
快滾！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You must have bright eyes to see that you finally came to this room.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你能找到這個房間，看來眼光很敏銳。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Once I was also an ordinary young man who traveled a lot and met many friends.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
曾經，我也只是一個四處旅行、結識了許多朋友的普通年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Master]
This is not a place where you can stay.
Please go back.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這裡不是你能停留的地方。
請回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Of course~
I have keen eyes.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
當然~
我的眼光很準。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You can't become a Sura unless you use all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
除非你用完所有的技能點，否則無法成為修羅。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You seem to be heavily burdened. Please remove some of it.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你似乎揹負了太重的東西。請卸下一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You don't seem to have reached the limit of a human, you still have far to go in order to become Sura.
Please go practice some more.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你似乎還沒有達到人類的極限，距離成為修羅還有很長的路要走。
請再去修煉一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Master! This is a wolf fur coat.
Put it on when it's cold.
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
師父！這是一件狼皮大衣。
天冷的時候請穿上。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahhk! That is the wolf I... caught... Uhh.
- Whack -

[Bruno]
Ho ho ho~
Do you have something to say, {0}?
You became a member of our family, let's get along together ~
scripts.translation:
[布魯諾]
呵呵呵~有話想說嗎，{0}？
進了同一個師門，以後可要好好相處哦~

scripts.text:
[Master]
Right, I now accept you as my student, too.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
沒錯，我也正式收你為徒了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I think you already know it, but to live as a Sura will not be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你應該已經明白，修羅這條路，並不好走。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I also shut myself off from the world. If there comes a day when we go to the world again, it must be the day when the world needs ghosts for the wars.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我已與塵世隔絕。
若有一天重返人間，必定是世間戰亂，需要鬼神出手之時。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I hope those days will not come but... I'll willingly be the ghost and kill all enemies.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
但願永遠沒有那一天...若真到那時，我自願化作鬼神，斬盡來敵。

scripts.text:
[Master]
So... please get down from your riding pet!
It is a loss of etiquette on this situation.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
所以...先從坐騎上下來！
這種場合還騎著坐騎，成何體統。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You should train yourself steadily until that day.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
在那一天到來之前，要堅持修煉，切勿懈怠。

scripts.text:
[Master]
However, as you might have felt, I finally faced my limitation.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
不過，正如你可能感受到的那樣，我終於觸碰到了自己的極限。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sometimes I wondered 'should I have to give up everything to be more powerful...?'
scripts.translation:
[師父]
有時我也會想，為求更強的力量，真的必須捨棄一切嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Master]
But what's done is done...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
但事已至此...
